name: Nose & smell

chart.yLabel: how strongly the smell is noticed (%)

overlay.caption: smell stays in the air · receptors quiet down · the brain stops getting the alarm

does: Shows the smell staying in the air while the sense of it fades
Shows smell receptors quieting down when a smell doesn't change (halving every 3 minutes)
Shows that a stronger smell takes longer to fade from notice
doesnt: Measure any real person or any real smell — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Include the brain's own habit of ignoring familiar things, which adds to the effect
Say anything about whether a smell is harmful
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: If you smell gas or smoke, don't wait to get used to it — leave and tell an adult right away.
